fields.title: Every store we run can be brought back

sections.Purpose: A store we cannot restore is a store we have already lost. We hold a copy of each one away from what it serves, and we prove the copy reads back before the day we need it to.
sections.Scope: Every store we operate, in every environment.
sections.Exceptions: A store we can rebuild from another store carries no copy of its own. We record what rebuilds it, and the clauses above bind whatever we rebuild it from.
